Mechanism confirmed on the wire, not from the bead hypothesis, which was wrong: Chromium resends verbatim on a fresh socket when the response is 408 AND the connection came out of its idle pool (RFC 7231 6.5.7). Controls: 409 on the same pooled connection does not resend; 408 on a freshly-opened socket does not resend; Connection: close does NOT suppress it.

Follow-up claude-scheduler-hn2 tracks the real repair — stop answering approval_timeout with 408 at all, which removes the retry trigger at the source rather than absorbing it.
